system.description:
Even other witches see you as particularly knowledgeable about magic. You gain the following benefits:

  • Your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You learn a spell of up to 4th level that is not part of the multiclass school from any spell list. It counts as a witch spell for you and is prepared as normal.

  • You gain proficiency with your choice of the herbalist’s kit, calligrapher’s supplies, bookbinder’s supplies, or the poisoner’s kit.

  • You gain an @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-adventuring-gear.Item.BySY77drzXa17ATW]{Athame}. It functions as a @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-adventuring-gear.Item.vzmgutyegssa2akj]{Dagger}, but is always considered a spellcasting focus for your witch spells. Once per short rest, when you hit a creature with a melee attack using it, you can spend a spell slot to deal a number of additional d6s of damage equal to the spell slot’s level +1. This bonus damage is radiant if you chose White Magic for your Witch’s Magic feature, psychic if you chose Gray Magic, and Necrotic if you chose Black Magic. If you lose your athame, you can replace it by performing an hour-long ritual with a dagger at the end of a long rest.
system.prerequisite: Magical Traditionalist feat, 8 levels in witch, no levels in non-witch classes at time of feat acquisition
